_comment: Example config. Copy this, fill in your own repository, roster, signals and copy, and keep YOUR filled-in version outside this repository if it contains organisation data.

copy.intro: Every in-scope pull request in this repository, split three ways: opened by automation, by the core team, or by everyone else. The filters scope the figures, the timeline and the ledger together.
methodWhyParas: Describe your signals here: which title tags, which branch prefixes, and what each one means. Hover any row's why cell to see which signals fired for that PR.
copy.methodExclusionHeading: What this page deliberately leaves out
copy.methodExclusionPara: State plainly anything the data cannot see, so a reader does not mistake a gap for a zero.
copy.methodProvNote: Provenance keys off the account that opened the pull request, never the title.
copy.methodCaveatHeading: Read this before you draw conclusions
methodCaveats: PR count is not work count. If some work reaches your default branch without a pull request, this page under-represents whoever did it.
Counts are per GitHub account, not per person, so anyone with two accounts is counted twice.
copy.methodRefreshPara: Explain what rebuilds the page and how to read the 'Data as of' stamp.
